title: Live: B1G Tailgate
description: Start off game day with the Big Ten Network crew previewing this week's games from around the conference. Plus, Camryn Irwin and Tyvis Powell travel to campus for interviews and on-site analysis. B1G Tailgate is the home for Big Ten football fans on Saturdays with original features, special guests and college football analysis.

title: Live: College Basketball
description: The No. 2 Michigan State Spartans host the Detroit Mercy Titans at Breslin Center in a basketball game. Michigan State broke a four-game win streak with a 61-46 loss against Tennessee, while Detroit Mercy searches for their first win this season.

title: Live: B1G Countdown to Kickoff
description: Countdown to Kickoff takes you on the field leading up to game time with previews of the day's biggest games, plus the latest news from reporters across the country.

title: Live: College Football
description: The Illinois Fighting Illini (6-4) host the No. 15 Iowa Hawkeyes (8-2) at Gies Memorial Stadium in an FBS Big Ten game. Iowa aims for a fourth straight win behind Hank Brown, while Illinois broke a four-game win streak with a 22-14 loss against UCLA.

title: B1G Live: Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: Live: College Football
description: The No. 18 USC Trojans host the Maryland Terrapins at Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in an NCAA football game. USC enters with alternate win-loss records in their last four games and looks for momentum, while Maryland aims for a three-game win streak.
